maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is tuition for degree and nursing programs from enrolled students, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Tuition largely paid via Title IV federal aid, military tuition assistance and GI Bill for AMU/APU, plus Rasmussen students.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by enrolling students at AMU, APU, Rasmussen and Hondros; Rasmussen and Hondros were occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Students can switch schools, though credit transfer and mid-program disruption add some friction; not core infrastructure for customers.

notes: Publicly funded share is judged from known reliance on federal student aid and military/veteran benefits, not stated on the page.
